strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN with TCP-shaped FakeTCP outer packets, UDP/datagram-like inner behavior, DTLS 1.3, and a compact WBD-owned FEC layer suited to OpenWrt/Linux/Windows owned endpoints.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: Replace the resource-heavy generic UDPspeeder process with a narrow WBD-owned FEC candidate, using UDPspeeder 20:20 as the oracle baseline and correcting the steady-state 200-Mbit sizing methodology.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not broaden the matrix. First implement one fixed 20+20 systematic erasure-code path with bounded buffers, then A/B only high-information 200-Mbit public-link points. Keep UDPspeeder until the candidate is at least as good on delivery/tail latency and materially better on RSS/CPU.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Recovered the live handoff from Issue #1 and dev/wbd-raw-fec-v2, reconciled checkpoint 9ba1ca8cee6d2d6a865b4ae96413c556a708c951 to live head 476139ec88a780ddf709bacb236b06e2e4a024e6 as one handoff-only delta, then completed the requested first WBD-owned FEC atomic step. Commits 7b01d7961bbfd4f75e5134c51d7ff3e96e6d7c0c and 43041da32cc67bf04197bdd00ec3ce1d75d99cd5 add internal/fec with a fixed systematic 20 data + 20 parity GF(256) Reed-Solomon codec, a thin replaceable Codec interface, a fixed-capacity preallocated BufferPool, and a repeated 56-byte BlockHeader carrying block/shard identity plus original packet lengths. Deterministic unit tests recover every missing-count 0..20 using both data-prefix and mixed loss patterns, reject 21 missing shards, round-trip variable-length metadata, and prove pool exhaustion is bounded. Exact tested local blobs match GitHub: fec.go b833ebd2a6089b16e1cf4afb85cc9eb2a4b5d33a and fec_test.go 8c0e61ed976cb68701dcb66d1ce83c6df9604fdd. Local Go 1.23.2 targeted tests pass. Indicative 1200-byte-shard microbench on the sandbox AMD EPYC reports about 43.04 MB/s encode and 40.84 MB/s worst-case reconstruction with all 20 data shards missing; this is only an implementation baseline, not the required transport A/B. Full-repository local tests were not run because the sandbox cannot resolve github.com for cloning, but this package has no external dependency and the exact committed package bytes were tested locally.
continuation_cursor.current_task: Build a minimal WBD-owned FEC v0 and A/B it against UDPspeeder 20:20. Preferred first codec is fixed systematic 20 data + 20 parity Reed-Solomon-style erasure coding with preallocated bounded block buffers, original packet-length metadata and a small flush timer. In parallel, correct the 200-Mbit sizing probe to separate one-way bulk throughput/CPU from a low-rate latency probe and to use actual measurement wall time.
continuation_cursor.why_now: The 200-Mbit pass shows UDPspeeder consumes about three quarters of current userspace RSS, while the project only needs one narrow fixed FEC behavior. The core 20+20 codec now exists and passes deterministic recovery tests, so the next risk is packet-preserving block lifecycle under variable lengths, reorder, partial blocks and bounded memory before transport integration.
continuation_cursor.done_when: A WBD-owned FEC candidate can encode/decode fixed 20+20 blocks, handle variable original packet lengths without stream semantics, bound memory explicitly, flush partial blocks on a small timer, pass deterministic loss/reorder unit tests, and run the corrected focused 200-Mbit A/B against the pinned UDPspeeder oracle. Report per-endpoint RSS, codec CPU, end-to-end CPU, one-way delivery/goodput and separate latency under a small set of RTT/loss points.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: Build the packet-preserving block layer around internal/fec: accept variable-length datagrams into a bounded 20-packet block, pad only inside the block, emit 40 independently parseable shard datagrams with BlockHeader, collect by BlockID/ShardIndex under arbitrary arrival order, reconstruct as soon as 20 valid shards are available, restore original datagram lengths, and flush a partial block on a small deterministic timer using DataCount. Add deterministic reorder/loss/partial-flush tests. Do not integrate with DTLS/FakeTCP or remove UDPspeeder until this block layer is locally qualified.
